q: By January 3, 2027 (the end of the 119th Congress), a law (a stand-alone bill or the National Defense Authorization Act) is enacted with the president's signature that contains at least one of the following: a provision banning sales of equipment and services to designated companies such as CXMT and YMTC, or a provision mandating U.S. extraterritorial controls if allies do not align by a deadline
basis: The MATCH Act cleared the House Foreign Affairs Committee 44–0 (April 22, 2026) and is included in the manager's amendment to the Senate NDAA, but the Senate NDAA is stalled. The White House opposes having its discretion limited by statute, and there is a precedent: in 2025 the GAIN AI Act was dropped from the NDAA during final negotiations after industry lobbying. Whether an exemption for South Korean companies' plants in China is included will be noted separately. · AI and Chips issue
